responsibility: Contains the scheduling model for the 64-bit Freescale e5500 processor. It describes decode, simple and complex fixed-point units, non-pipelined divide, LSU, FPU, and branch resources and gives class-specific timing for integer, compare, shift, load/store, multiply/divide, CR, branch, and FP instructions, making it the rs6000 scheduler input for the e5500 core.
